'''Larit''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was present in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:P25" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|OK well I can't pay you anything but me and the fellows are looking to score something soon and we could use something nondescript for us to wear ... to avoid getting ourselves fingered. You think you can do that?|Larit, to a spacer|<ref name="stf">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; tatooine_knives_parry_larit.stf</ref>}}
Larit was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P25" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Larit was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Larit was intended to be part of the cancelled [https://swglegends.com/forums/showthread.php?55817-*Friday-Feature-Valarian-Themepark-Walkthrough!*Valarian Themepark]. This questline was initially planned to be introduced in the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" to replace the original "[[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Valarian Quest Series]]."<ref name="SonyCite-Valarian Quest Update">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Current%20Publish|text=Valarian Quest Update}}</ref> Although the old "Valarian Quest Series" was deactivated with the release of Publish 23 on [[August 31]], [[2005]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref> the new Themepark was never activated.<ref name="SonyCite-In Development">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> NPCs of the Valarian Theme Park such as Larit were implemented into the game but they were not involved in any quest.<ref name="SWG:P25" /> Unused game files pertaining to this questline indicated that Larit was intended to be part of a new quest named "Parry." In this quest, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] henchman Larit tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with making shirts for the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian gang]].<ref>{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash;  tatooine_knives_parry.stf</ref>
